title: Switching between Activities very slow (background takes a second to refresh)
line: Switching activities no longer flashes a black desktop: the new wallpaper slides in over the old one.
explanation: When the activity changes, libplasma's ContainmentView hides the old desktop containment before the desktop shell's QML gets the new one. Desktop.qml then runs its switch animation, sliding the new containment in from the right while 'sliding out' the old one, which is already invisible, so the screen shows black until the new desktop has slid across. The change makes the old containment visible again at the start of the animation; the animation's last step already hides it.

commits.message:
desktoppackage: keep the old desktop visible while switching activities

The old activity's desktop is hidden as soon as the containment changes,
so the new one slid in over an empty black window. Show it again while
the switch animation runs, so the new desktop slides over the old one.

review.text: Setting internal.oldContainment.visible = true in the initial ScriptAction of switchAnim in Desktop.qml cleanly fixes the black flash during activity switching caused by ContainmentView hiding the old containment before the slide animation begins. The final ScriptAction and rapid-switch interruption path already hide oldContainment reliably, and the frame strips and recordings confirm the new wallpaper slides over the old one with no black frames.

reviews.text: Setting internal.oldContainment.visible = true in the initial ScriptAction of switchAnim in Desktop.qml cleanly fixes the black flash during activity switching caused by ContainmentView hiding the old containment before the slide animation begins. The final ScriptAction and rapid-switch interruption path already hide oldContainment reliably, and the frame strips and recordings confirm the new wallpaper slides over the old one with no black frames.

The one-liner is correct and well placed. ContainmentView hides the old item without reparenting it, and Desktop.qml's switch animation owns visibility from then on, so showing the old item again removes the black frames during the slide, as the before/after strips show. But the reporter (and the entry's own notes) describe the new background taking 1-2 s to appear. The other activity's containment item and wallpaper are created lazily (itemForApplet) on the first switch, and the image loads asynchronously. If loading outlasts the animation, the final ScriptAction still hides the old desktop over an empty new one, so black-then-wallpaper remains. That case was not tested: every recorded switch was a repeat switch with small images on a fast rig.
changes: Test the first switch to an activity after plasmashell starts, with a large image wallpaper (e.g. a 4K or 8K JPEG, or a slideshow), and record whether black appears after the slide.

If it does, keep the old containment visible until the new containment's wallpaper has finished loading, e.g. delay the final hide in switchAnim until the wallpaper reports it is loaded, so neither the slide nor the load ever shows black.
